description: The REPLACE statement's stacking phrases — format 1 REPLACE ALSO and format 2 REPLACE LAST OFF (ISO §2023:7.2.4.2; the §2023:7.2.4.4 GR4-GR7 active / inactive-LIFO / canceled state machine). PROVISIONAL pre-2023 edge (zero Annex E hits => predates 2023; per decision 1, as constant-entry-2002): a COBOL-2002 introduction. ACTIVE since kb/Work PB1357: CopyProcessor.ApplyReplaceStatements parses both phrases and drives ReplaceStates; the introduction gate is its Gate() on the ALSO / LAST word (frontend, COBOL0900 below 2002).
vcr: ISO §2023:7.2.4.2 format 1 ALSO / format 2 LAST; provisional edge per decision 1
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRAL.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 AA PIC X(2) VALUE "AA".
01 BB PIC X(2) VALUE "BB".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
REPLACE ==XX1== BY ==AA==.
REPLACE ALSO ==XX2== BY ==BB==.
    DISPLAY XX1 XX2.
REPLACE LAST OFF.
    DISPLAY XX1.
REPLACE OFF.
    STOP RUN.
